info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Update Economic Capital Model API
info.description: This API allows businesses to modify existing economic capital models within their banking systems. By utilizing the PATCH method, users can adjust parameters or details of specific models identified by the unique path parameter. Typical consumers of this API include financial analysts and risk managers who need to ensure that their economic capital modeling reflects the most current data and regulatory requirements. Efficiently maintaining accurate economic capital models is critical for risk assessment and strategic decision-making in financial institutions.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of the Economic Capital Model identified by RES-100045. You can modify various attributes to ensure that the model reflects the most accurate and up-to-date information relevant to your financial risk assessments.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the economic capital model identified by RES-100045. It accepts a structured JSON object that specifies the changes to be made to the model's existing properties and values.
